title: The tour with Juanma was...
text: The tour with Juanma was fantastic! He was very friendly and had tons of interesting information. The tapas restaurant was delicious and the flamenco dancing at El Paraigua was phenomenal. Highly recommended!

title: Great time!
text: Had a great time on this tour with Juan.  He was so informative and courteous.  Great tapas and show.  Would definitely recommend!
author: Jose_G

title: Amazing
text: The tour guide waited on us when we were stuck in traffic which we so appreciated. Then we got a historical tour, tapas in a local place followed by the dancing. Great way to see local culture. There was music in many places as we walked. I highly recommend.
author: Rose_O

title: Great night out on Barcelona!
text: Great experience with Juanma! He was on-time and easy to find, very personalble and knowledgeable. Our group was mixed ages - young adults & seniors,  and he was great with everyone. The experience exceeded our expectations and was one of the most fun evenings on our trip. The tapas offered we're excellent and we all loved the flemanco show!

title: Barcelona Experience
text:
We had so much fun. Miquel, our guide, was fun, interesting, informative and caring.
 It was a small group so we got to interact with each other and meet people from all over the world while sharing a great tapas dinner.
Flamenco was awesome. So close to the stage we could see and hear everything so well. 
Great value
